name: Mama Kat's Restaurant

Photo3 is a separate printed page repeating the drinks/bakery items from photo2 ('Quick Grabs') but also adding House Specialties and Eggs Benedict sections, which were merged in; pure drink/espresso listings on photos 2-3 were skipped as drink-only content. One duplicate 'Sunrise Sandwich' on photo3 (priced differently) was treated as the same dish already captured from photo1.
